title: Determinant-line isomorphism for an exact sequence of finite projective modules
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $0\to U\xrightarrow{i}V\xrightarrow{p}W\to0$ be an exact sequence of $R$-modules, meaning that $i$ is injective, $p$ is surjective and $\operatorname{im}(i)=\ker(p)$. Assume $U,V,W$ are direct summands of finite free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. For any such module $E$, its determinant module $\det_R(E)$ is obtained on finite free localizations [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover] by taking the top exterior power [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] and identifying these rank-one modules on overlaps using the top exterior powers of change-of-basis maps; the determinant of the zero module is $R$. These local modules define an invertible $R$-module (a finite projective module locally free of rank one). Tensor products are as in [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. There is a canonical isomorphism $\gamma_{i,p}:\det_R(U)\otimes_R\det_R(W)\xrightarrow{\sim}\det_R(V)$. On a localization where $U,W$ have bases $u_1,\ldots,u_r$ and $w_1,\ldots,w_s$, its formula is
$$\gamma_{i,p}((u_1\wedge\cdots\wedge u_r)\otimes(w_1\wedge\cdots\wedge w_s))=i(u_1)\wedge\cdots\wedge i(u_r)\wedge\widetilde w_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\widetilde w_s,$$
where $p(\widetilde w_j)=w_j$. This formula is independent of the lifts and bases and commutes with further localization; it includes $r=0$ and $s=0$.

source.place: Tag 0FJB (lemma-det-ses), first and second constructions, with the determinant-module definition preceding it.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-split-exterior-comparison-localization] to split the given sequence; its splitting and inverse localize, so every localized sequence is split exact. Choose finite standard free covers of $U,W$ using [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover]. Their pairwise products still generate the unit ideal: multiply the two expressions for $1$. On this common cover $U,W$ have ranks $r_a,s_a$ and the splitting identifies $V$ with their direct sum: the images of the two bases form a basis of $V$ of length $r_a+s_a$.

source.place: Tag 0FJB (lemma-det-ses), first proof, split free charts

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-projective-determinant-chart-descent] to $U,W,V$. Its exterior-localization chart identifications give their invertible determinant modules and $\det_R(0)=R$. On each chart, [lem-trf-split-exterior-comparison-localization] gives the required top-wedge isomorphism and arbitrary-lift formula, independently of bases and splitting. On a nonzero overlap the ranks agree by chart-descent. For any pure tensor of pure wedges use the localized section from step 1 to choose the same lifts for both maps. Split-exterior and its localization clause then give the same output wedge. Pure wedges span each exterior power [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], and pure tensors span their tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], so the maps agree. On a zero overlap there is just one map. Thus the supplied pairings satisfy the overlap hypothesis of pairing descent.

source.place: Tag 0FJB (lemma-det-ses), first proof, local wedge comparisons

proof.text: Use the supplied-pairing descent clause of [lem-trf-projective-determinant-chart-descent], with $(E_1,E_2,E_3)=(U,W,V)$ and the isomorphisms of step 2. It gives the unique global $\gamma_{i,p}$ and its inverse, independently of refinement. For any further localization $R\to B$ where $U_B,W_B$ are free, compare its localized map with the free wedge map of [lem-trf-split-exterior-comparison-localization]. On the standard cover of $B$ obtained from step 1, both maps have the same arbitrary-lift formula by step 2 and split-exterior localization. Uniqueness in chart-descent over $B$ makes them equal. Thus the formula holds on every free localization with every basis and lift tuple, and commutes with successive localizations. Split-exterior supplies the empty-wedge unit formulas and zero-ring case; chart-descent supplies $\det_R(0)=R$.

source.place: Tag 0FJB (lemma-det-ses), first proof, descent of compatible isomorphisms

split_report.summary: Rebased the retained reader-approved re-split onto the current live DAG after the side-completion landing refusal. Kept the statement, statement dependencies, metadata, two statement-only nodes and logged searches. The chart-descent node owns determinant construction, socle comparison and descent of supplied compatible pairings; the split-exterior node owns splitting and the free wedge calculation with lift independence and localization. The three-step assembly explicitly constructs a simultaneous free cover including V, verifies overlap equality on spanning pure wedge tensors, and uses uniqueness over every further free localization to establish the displayed formula there. All eight original arguments remain verbatim in the report; no unit or chapter route changed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q101-bc6e64e1a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: This is the 4th push of the same re-split. Heads 44dc63699, edae48a39 and e2eaddace all got PASS, and each landing was refused only because the completion was 'not in the live DAG'. In live and side-live the item is still split with the old 8-step proof. The released stage-1 re-split note (2026-10-21/22, at least 2 statement-only nodes, assembly at most 3000 characters) still applies, so the item is not superseded. Compared field by field with the live node, only proof, proof_deps, proof_origin and split_report differ; the statement, stmt_deps and maintainer fields are unchanged. Compared with e2eaddace, both new nodes are identical. Step 1 adds one clause: the images of the U and W bases form a basis of V of length r_a+s_a. This is correct because t_s is an isomorphism, so every cover member is a simultaneous free chart. Step 3 is rewritten. For any localization R->B with U_B and W_B free, the descended map localized to B and split-exterior's theta over B agree on the image cover of B, which still generates 1. This uses the split-exterior localization clause and the step-2 overlap equality. Chart-descent's uniqueness-under-localization clause then makes the two maps equal. This is sound and makes the earlier 'preserves further localization' wording explicit. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. The steps are 533, 877 and 841 characters, 2251 in total. Sources rechecked: Stacks more-algebra.tex 36228-36335 (0FJ9 definition; 0FJA socle remark; 0FJB first proof, kernel-first rule, which omits well-definedness) and 00EK cover descent. No SGA is cited. Every old step 1-8 is a stated clause of chart-descent (2268 chars) or split-exterior (2064 chars), and neither node restates the item. Checks: on a free chart the socle is the top wedge, including rank 0. The socle localizes for finitely generated E. Lift independence uses alternation, so characteristic 2 is covered. r=0 gives the inverse of p on wedges; s0=0 gives the r-th exterior power of i; both zero gives multiplication. The zero ring and product rings with varying ranks are covered. Duplicate search: the new base node lem-trf-projective-exterior-scalar-comparisons has the item as a stmt_dep, so it is not a duplicate and citing it would create a cycle. def-mg-determinant-line and the sheaf-level lem-sc-*/new-y3 nodes are not duplicates. Accepted tool_use: lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover. Advisory: split-exterior could cite lem-sc-exterior-top-direct-sum. reviewed_lean.note: Checked every node clause against the Lean. The socle determinant module (Stacks remark-determinant-as-socle) is identified with chart top wedges by determinantModule_topExterior and determinantModule_localization (IsLocalizedModule), is finite projective of rank one on a standard cover, and equals R for zero modules. existsUnique_determinantExactSequence characterizes the unique iso by the 0FJB second-construction formula x'∧t for every lift t: checked well-defined (ker of ⋀p is the ideal generated by i(U); graded commutativity), and unique because pure tensors span and ⋀p is surjective. The wedge formula covers all bases, tuples and lifts, Fin 0 included; the localization square is checked by naturality on ι-generators. Hypotheses are exactly Finite+Projective, injective, surjective, Exact; universes are independent; edge cases R=0, zero modules, varying rank and char 2 are fine. The new node def-trf-projective-determinant-module matches the source and the §5 field list, has real data, and duplicates nothing in the side DAG, Sheaf or Mathlib (the sc sheaf determinant is constant-rank). All proofs are sorry; docstrings carry source and blueprint id; lean.statement fields are verbatim; lines are at most 100 characters. Both modules compile cleanly with nt_compile.py --json (1.8 s, 3.2 s). Observations only: the Second reading section is an openly declared author self-check, and the wedge theorem has unused hypotheses hex/_bU/_bW.
